Miso wakes up and looks out of the window.
It is summer, but it is snowing!
The sun comes out, and the snow melts away.
Time for breakfast!
Miso pours a glass of milk and smells it.
The milk is old. It smells very bad!
Sam pours the old milk away.
Sam gives Miso fresh orange juice instead. It smells nice and sweet.
At the park, Miso gets a big red balloon on a string.
Red is Miso's favorite color!
Whoosh! The wind pulls the balloon string away from Miso.
The red balloon floats up, up, up into the sky.
Sam has two balloons.
Sam gives one to Miso. Now they each have a balloon.
Miso builds a tower with blocks. One block, two blocks, ten blocks!
It is the tallest tower Miso has ever made.
Miso has a very tall tower of blocks.
Sam pushes the tower over, on purpose.
Crash! All the blocks fall down.
Sam comes back and says, 'I am sorry. That was not kind.'
Then the two of them build the tower again, together.
In the park, a big dog runs up to Miso.
Woof! Woof! The dog barks very loudly.
Sam calls, 'Rufus, come here!'
The dog sits down next to Sam and wags its tail. Rufus is Sam's dog, and he is friendly.
Miso finds a toy box with a little handle and turns it round and round.
Music plays. Then, pop! A toy jumps out of the box on a spring!
It is a jack-in-the-box.
Miso pushes the toy back in, ready to play again.
Miso has a picnic in the garden and takes a big bite of an apple.
Inside the apple there is a little wiggly worm!
Miso puts the apple on the grass for the worm.
Sam gives Miso a banana instead. It is clean and sweet.
At the bakery, Miso carries a chocolate cake to the table.
The cake slips. Splat! It falls on the floor.
Sam comes over with a smile.
Sam shares a cupcake with a cherry on top. 'Accidents happen,' says Sam.
In the afternoon, the sky goes dark.
There is a flash of lightning. Then, boom! The thunder is very loud.
Sam sits next to Miso and holds Miso's paw.
The two of them wait together until the storm is over. Then the sun comes out again.
Today is party day!
Ding dong! Sam is at the door, with cake and balloons!
Miso helps make pancakes. Mix, pour, flip!
The pancakes are round and warm, and Miso gets the first one.
At the bakery, Miso and Sam put sprinkles on a big cake.
Lots and lots of sprinkles!
Miso's favorite toy car has a broken wheel.
The car cannot roll any more.
Sam helps fix the wheel with glue.
Tomorrow the car can roll again.
Miso builds a sandcastle on the beach.
A wave comes and washes the sandcastle away.
Miso builds a new sandcastle, higher up on the sand.
The waves cannot reach it there.
Miso watches corn seeds in a pot with a glass lid.
Then, pop, pop, pop! The seeds jump up and turn into popcorn!
Now there is a big bowl of warm popcorn.
Miso lifts up a big leaf in the garden.
Hop! A little rabbit jumps out from under it!
The rabbit hops away into the bushes.
Miso wants to go outside, but the zip on the coat is stuck.
Miso pulls and pulls. The zip stays stuck, again and again.
Sam shows how to do it: hold the bottom, then pull slowly.
Zip! The coat is closed. Off to the park!
Miso is drawing a big picture of a house.
Sam says, 'Stop now. It is time to go to the bakery.' The picture is not finished.
'You can finish it when we come home,' says Sam.
Miso puts the picture in a safe place on the shelf.
Miso goes into the garden shed. It is dark inside.
Something moves in the corner. Rustle, rustle!
Sam opens the door wide, and the light comes in.
It is a little bird. The bird flies out into the garden.
Miso is playing on the beach.
A big wave rushes up the sand, very fast, right up to Miso!
Sam takes Miso's paw, and they run up the sand together.
The wave slides back into the sea. Now the two of them play on the dry sand.
At the bakery, Miso picks up an old bread roll from the back of a shelf.
Underneath, the bread is green and fuzzy. It is moldy!
Sam puts the old roll in the bin.
Then Sam gives Miso a fresh, warm roll.
Miso steps on a pile of seaweed.
It is cold and slimy, and it smells like old fish.
Miso washes the slime off in the clean sea water.
All clean again!
